questions.passage: Many animals around the world are in danger. This means they are in danger of disappearing forever. Some animals are in danger because of cutting down trees, pollution and hunting animals. Examples of endangered animals are the Arabian Leopard, the Red Sea Dugong and giant panda. We can protect endangered animals by protecting their homes, planting trees, keeping the environment clean and not hunting animals.
